articles.title: Samuel L. Jackson Says Nick Fury Will Return in 'Avengers: Secret Wars'
articles.summary: Samuel L. Jackson won't appear in 'Avengers: Doomsday,' but he says Nick Fury will be back in the next Avengers movie, 'Secret Wars.'

articles.title: One October Holiday, Two Names: Columbus Day and Indigenous Peoples' Day
articles.summary: On October 12, Americans will mark a holiday that some call Columbus Day and others call Indigenous Peoples' Day. Here is why it has two names.

articles.title: Phish Gets Ready for Its 100th Show at Madison Square Garden
articles.summary: The rock band Phish will play its 100th concert at New York's Madison Square Garden on January 2, and the arena's workers helped celebrate in a video.
